text:
ryan_customer: hitting a 400 on /v1/rerank — started after our frontend deploy. payload is tiny/minified, server returns 400 with no helpful body. anyone seen this?

jessica_support: sorry about that — can you paste the exact request (headers + body) you sent? 400 could be schema or content-type.

ryan_customer: here's what we sent (copied from client logs):
`POST /v1/rerank`
Headers: `Authorization: Bearer <redacted>`, `Content-Type: application/json`
Body:
`{"id":"req-77","top_k":"5","queries":[{"id":"q1","text":"what is redis?"}],"candidates":{"0":{"id":"c1","text":"key-value store"}}}`

jessica_support: quick glance — two issues: `top_k` is a string not a number, and `candidates` is an object with numeric keys rather than an array. our API expects `items` / `candidates` arrays depending on client, and numeric fields must be numbers. that will cause a 400 schema validation.

jessica_support: can you repro with curl that includes pretty JSON so we can see full error body? sometimes minified clients hide server error messages.

ryan_customer: tried curl, got: 400 Bad Request 
Response body: `{"error":{"message":"invalid request: candidates must be array","code":400}}`

devin_eng: fwiw, we've seen this shape before — some frontends serialize a Map or object with numeric keys which turns arrays into objects. also older SDKs accidentally send numeric params as strings when coming from form inputs.

jessica_support: repro steps I ran locally: 1) send that exact payload -> 400 with message above. 2) change payload to correct types/array -> 200. Example working body:
```json
{
  "id": "req-77",
  "top_k": 5,
  "queries": [ { "id": "q1", "text": "what is redis?" } ],
  "candidates": [ { "id": "c1", "text": "key-value store" } ]
}
```
Curl to test:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"id":"req-77","top_k":5,"queries":[{"id":"q1","text":"what is redis?"}],"candidates":[{"id":"c1","text":"key-value store"}]}'
```

devin_eng: action: we'll add a short troubleshooting note to the rerank docs about object-vs-array serialization and strict typing. also adding a warning to the JS SDK to coerce numeric inputs.

jessica_support: for now the quick fix is to ensure candidates is an array and top_k is numeric in the client before sending. if you want, paste the minimal client code and we can suggest a patch.

ryan_customer: thanks — found the bug, our UI was doing `Object.fromEntries(formData)` and then `JSON.stringify` which turned repeated fields into an object. switching to an array fixed it. :thumbsup:

jessica_support: great, marking resolved. leaving thread open one more day to confirm no other occurrences. cc @devin_eng to follow up on docs/SDK note.

sre-bot: deploy succeeded: docs update draft created (#1234).

ryan_customer: verified in prod, 200 now. thanks for the fast help! :tada:
